influences.name: Bladee
influences.context: I cited Bladee's Cold Visions in the press bio as a recent influence... So I heard Cold Visions, and obviously James Ferraro worked on it—all of those weird sound effects.

influences.name: Tyler the Creator
influences.context: When I was in high school making music, Tyler the Crater and Odd Future were blowing up and I was very much plugged into that world. They had more to do with how I approached music than anything in American primitive guitar.

influences.name: Kanye West
influences.context: Yeezus came out, and that was a huge deal for me.

influences.name: Jim O'Rourke
influences.context: I set out to make a record as good or better than Jim O'Rourke's Bad Timing. That's what I'm aiming for.

influences.name: Dylan
influences.context: I'm going to try & follow Dylan's advice here & say DON'T LOOK BACK.

influences.name: Daniel Johnston
influences.context: Would you ever consider doing a Daniel Johnston cover? Yes I would… & I've even considered it.
